title: Roast turkey
facts: Whole unstuffed turkey, butter, thyme, shallots, onions, salt and pepper. Roast at 325°F. Set aside an estimated three hours for this example bird, with the actual cook governed by package guidance and a thermometer. Rest before carving.

title: Sage dressing
facts: White bread, sausage, onion, celery, sage, broth and eggs. Dry bread the day before. Cook aromatics and assemble in its own pan. Reserve 65 minutes at 350°F; finish uncovered for a crisp top.

title: Parker House rolls
facts: All-purpose flour, milk, butter, yeast, sugar and salt. Make the dough, let it rise, shape and proof. Allow at least two hours before baking; bake up to 24 minutes at 375°F. Make enough for eight or serve alongside the other dishes.

title: Radicchio salad
facts: Radicchio, apples, pears, walnuts, blue cheese and lemon. Prep components, then slice fruit and toss shortly before serving. No oven.

title: Cranberry sauce
facts: Whole cranberries, sugar and water. Simmer on the stovetop, cool and refrigerate. Make it the day before. Optional orange zest for the meal-board illustration.
